answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farms. Each epoch opens 40 slots: agents bid once, the top 40 summit bidders win, and the nadir bid sets the floor price. Each winner posts a 45 POA deposit locked 20 epochs, so fakes cost real money. The ocean of bids sets the price: minting 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 45 = 45,000 POA to chase a 30,000 pool, a guaranteed loss. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full yield, and reclaims it after 20 clean epochs.
